situation: Group-owned seal maker running at full capacity and allocating standard mechanical seals by last year's call-offs. For us that means 19,360 pc of 340010 against a forecast of 21,310 (+10.1 %). It is our only source for the 24 mm seal. It explicitly prioritises customers with firm, long-term commitments, and extra volume only comes against a binding 12-month commitment. We are a small customer (0.5 % of its turnover) and price moves above 2 % go to a pricing committee that meets every two weeks. P10 is secure_supply: buy coverage with commitment, not with threats.
